text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No human overdosage data has been reported for fluticasone propionate and salmeterol inhalation powder. Wixela Inhub ® contains both fluticasone propionate and salmeterol; therefore, the risks associated with overdosage for the individual components described below apply to Wixela Inhub ® . Treatment of overdosage consists of discontinuation of Wixela Inhub ® together with institution of appropriate symptomatic and/or supportive therapy. The judicious use of a cardioselective beta-receptor blocker may be considered, bearing in mind that such medication can produce bronchospasm. Cardiac monitoring is recommended in cases of overdosage.
